description: Main-window capability: core defaults + the four window-control grants (w28 fix 3 — the frameless title bar). Every UI-originated command flows EXCLUSIVELY through the single lumen_dispatch command (doc 05 §5.1 single-command rule); engine events arrive on the lumen://event channel, covered by core:event:default. The window grants are the ONLY direct core commands the UI may invoke (plugin:window|minimize / toggle_maximize / close / start_dragging): the shell's custom title bar (banner) IS the window chrome now (decorations:false, w28 fix 2), and chrome controls are not engine commands — they never touch lumen_dispatch. No plugin permissions are granted.
